newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan March industrial output falls 1.5 pct--MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan March industrial output falls 1.5 pct--MITI.

text.p: Japan's industrial production in March fell a preliminary 1.5 percent from the previous month on a seasonally adjusted basis, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Monday.

Industrial production in the January-March period rose 2.1 percent from the previous quarter, and was up 6.6 percent from a year ago. MITI said in a statement that industrial output was on an upward trend.
Industrial output in the fiscal year that ended March 31 rose 4.1 percent from the previous year.
